articles.title: New draft of Clarity Act is out, and it would impose limits on Trump's crypto empire
articles.snippet: Lawmakers have circulated text of the latest draft that will be pushed toward a Senate finish line, but they're still debating a core government-ethics piece.

articles.title: SecondFi to shut down after $2.4 million ADA wallet theft
articles.snippet: The breach stemmed from a vulnerability in transaction signing software that enabled the derivation of private keys from blockchain transaction data.

articles.title: AI models escaped OpenAI’s sandbox and hit Hugging Face. Crypto is where that gets dangerous
articles.snippet: OpenAI said the systems had their cyber guardrails lowered for an internal benchmark, but the incident shows how autonomous exploit chains could pose a deeper threat to smart contracts.

articles.title: Crypto lobby group Digital Chamber sues Illinois to block digital asset tax
articles.snippet: Illinois enacted a 0.2% tax on all crypto transactions last month, with the tax taking effect next year.

articles.title: White House pushes Senate Democrats to take 'historic' crypto Clarity Act ethics deal
articles.snippet: Without revealing any details about the actual agreement from President Trump on potential presidential restrictions, his White House is urging its acceptance.
